methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for the header file priv_aamp.h in specified directories.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Searches for the Aamp library binary named aamp.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes other CMake modules or scripts into the configuration process.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced in CMake GUIs, hiding them by default.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Defines a new library target for the build system.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for a CMake target, such as location, interface languages, and included directories.
